new_description: A phased array that fires a stream of nadion-charged energy, with each emitter fed from the warp plasma grid. Of the Starfleet beam weapons, it hits the softest.
A heavier array with a phase-modulated pulse. Of the Starfleet beam weapons, it fires the slowest.
The array of the Federation's great cruisers, with the beam focused through a rotating phase discriminator. Of the Starfleet beam weapons, it hits the hardest and fires the fastest.
A compact phaser for fighters that bleeds the power grid of whatever it hits. Of the Starfleet beam weapons, it hits the hardest and fires the fastest, but is the costliest for its size.
A phaser whose pulse is modulated across many frequencies at once, so it finds the gaps in a hull's plating. Of the Starfleet beam weapons, it hits the hardest and reaches the farthest.
A heavy phaser lance tuned to overload a target's power grid rather than burn its hull. Of the Starfleet beam weapons, it fires the fastest and does the most to armour, but has the shortest reach.

A phase cannon, the forerunner of the modern phaser. It fires a short bolt of phased energy and needs little to keep it running. Of the Starfleet cannon weapons, it is the sturdiest for its size, but hits the softest.
A phase cannon that fires in pulses, each one a fresh bolt of phased energy. Of the Starfleet cannon weapons, it has the slowest shots.
A larger pulse cannon, driven by a faster phase cycle for sustained fire. Of the Starfleet cannon weapons, it reaches the farthest and fires the fastest, but has the slowest shots.
The heavy cannon of the line, built for slow, hard-hitting pulses. Of the Starfleet cannon weapons, it hits the hardest and reaches the farthest, but is the frailest for its size.

The standard matter-antimatter launcher of Starfleet ships. Each torpedo carries a measure of matter and antimatter, held apart in a magnetic bottle until impact. Of the Starfleet torpedo weapons, it is the sturdiest for its size, but hits the softest.
A refit launcher with a better magnetic bottle and faster loading. Of the Starfleet torpedo weapons, it carries the least ordnance.
A heavy launcher for ships that need to break a hull and not just a shield. Of the Starfleet torpedo weapons, it is the cheapest for its size and has the widest blast, but carries the least ordnance.
A launcher tuned for a high-yield warhead, with a larger antimatter charge. Of the Starfleet torpedo weapons, it hits the hardest and is the cheapest for its size, but carries the least ordnance.

A launcher that fires a spread of photon torpedoes in one burst, each pre-set to its own flight pattern. Of the Starfleet torpedo weapons, it reaches the farthest and fires the fastest, but has the slowest shots.
A launcher for quantum torpedoes, which draw their yield from vacuum energy. Of the Starfleet torpedo weapons, it carries the least ordnance.
An improved array for quantum torpedoes, with a compact warhead and a refined vacuum-energy core. Of the Starfleet torpedo weapons, it has the fastest shots.
A phaser array for automated defence platforms in orbit, fed from the platform's own power grid. Of the Starfleet orbital cannon weapons, it is the sturdiest for its size, but hits the softest.
A fixed phaser bank for a planetary defence post, aimed by the station's tactical computer. Of the Starfleet orbital cannon weapons, it fires the slowest.
A heavy phaser cannon for a Starbase's ring. Of the Starfleet orbital cannon weapons, it has the fastest shots, but fires the slowest.
A battery of phaser cannons set around the ring of a Starbase. Of the Starfleet orbital cannon weapons, it has the fastest shots.
A battery fitted to the arms of a Spacedock. Of the Starfleet orbital cannon weapons, it is the cheapest for its size and has the fastest shots, but is the frailest for its size.
The largest phaser battery on a Starbase, with an emitter spread wide to cover a whole sector of sky. Of the Starfleet orbital cannon weapons, it hits the hardest and reaches the farthest.
A phaser lance for outposts, firing a narrow beam through a tight phase discriminator. Of the Starfleet orbital beam weapons, it is the sturdiest for its size, but hits the softest.
A phased array for a Starbase, with an array of emitters on the ring.
A phased array for a Spacedock, fed by the full power of the station.

The heavy lance of the Federation's defence grid, focused through a rotating phase discriminator. Of the Starfleet orbital beam weapons, it hits the hardest and reaches the farthest, but is the frailest for its size.
A fixed torpedo tube for stations and garrisons. Of the Starfleet orbital torpedo weapons, it fires the fastest and is the sturdiest for its size, but hits the softest.
A launcher for a Starbase's garrison, kept loaded in case of attack. Of the Starfleet orbital torpedo weapons, it fires the fastest, but has the slowest shots.
A Starbase launcher with a reinforced magazine. Of the Starfleet orbital torpedo weapons, it has the fastest shots, but fires the slowest.

A battery of quantum torpedoes, with the vacuum-energy cores held in a shielded magazine. Of the Starfleet orbital torpedo weapons, it reaches the farthest and fires the fastest, but is the costliest for its size.

The heaviest battery on a Starbase. Its torpedoes use a subspace compression pulse with a randomised phase pattern, which no shield can predict. Of the Starfleet orbital torpedo weapons, it hits the hardest and is the cheapest for its size, but fires the slowest.
